en-US.Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, r: Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, ratings are untouched. Expect 2–8 minutes.
en-US.Draw one edge between two dots. Close al: Draw one edge between two dots. Close all four sides of a box to claim it — and draw again.
en-US.Pip likes random lines. Take every free: Pip likes random lines. Take every free box it hands you.
en-US.Some lines are already inked. Work aroun: Some lines are already inked. Work around them.
en-US.MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free: MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free box. Beat her by two.
en-US.Three pencils now. Watch who follows who: Three pencils now. Watch who follows whom — claimed boxes grant extra turns.
en-US.MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish: MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish inside the limit.
en-US.MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open: MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open one you cannot close.
en-US.Four pencils. Every pass is someone else: Four pencils. Every pass is someone else's chance.
MASTERY: inked lines, a clock, and Vega. Win by three.
en-US.MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is p: MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is patient — outlast her.
Win by four. Every chain matters.
en-US.MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega,: MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega, on the clock.
en-US.MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at h: MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at her best.
en-US.MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, ti: MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, timed, against Vega. The final sheet.
Win a 3×3 sheet in under a minute.
en-US.Forty-two boxes against Margot. Settle i: Forty-two boxes against Margot. Settle in.
en-US.Margot opens. Six lines are already inke: Margot opens. Six lines are already inked. Win anyway.
Three rivals, one sheet. Finish first.
en-US.Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never: Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never fills.
Beat Vega at her own game. No hints.
en-US.One shared sheet for everyone today. Mos: One shared sheet for everyone today. Most boxes wins.
en-US.Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge bet: Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge between two dots, then confirm. Draw two lines to finish.
Three sides of the middle box are drawn. Close the fourth side to claim it.
en-US.Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your: Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your hand. Claim both boxes in one turn.
en-US.A line that gives a box its third side h: A line that gives a box its third side hands it away. Draw three safe lines — the lamp marks risky edges when you hover them.
en-US.Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim mor: Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim more boxes than your rival to win.
en-US.Title: Title
en-US.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Tap a faint edge between two dots (or move the focus ring with arrow keys and press Enter). One line per turn.
en-US.When your line closes the fourth side of: When your line closes the fourth side of a box, the box folds into your color and stamp — and you draw again.
en-US.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Claimed boxes grant another line immediately. Long chains swing a match; so can giving one away.
en-US.The third side is a gift: The third side is a gift
en-US.A line that gives a box its third side u: A line that gives a box its third side usually hands it to your rival. The risk lamp warns you before you commit.
When the sheet is full, most boxes wins. Ties break on fewer invalid moves, then faster time.

es-419.Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, r: La práctica no cuenta para la clasificación: puedes deshacer y tu nivel no cambia. Calcula de 2 a 8 minutos.
es-419.Draw one edge between two dots. Close al: Traza un lado entre dos puntos. Cierra los cuatro lados de una caja para ganarla, y vuelve a trazar.
es-419.Pip likes random lines. Take every free: A Pip le gustan las líneas al azar. Toma cada caja gratis que te regale.
es-419.Some lines are already inked. Work aroun: Algunas líneas ya están entintadas. Juega alrededor de ellas.
es-419.MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free: MAESTRÍA: Margot nunca regala una caja. Gánale por dos.
es-419.Three pencils now. Watch who follows who: Ahora hay tres lápices. Fíjate en quién va después de quién: las cajas ganadas dan turnos extra.
es-419.MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish: MAESTRÍA: llega un reloj al escritorio. Termina dentro del límite.
es-419.MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open: MAESTRÍA: Vega cuenta las cadenas. No abras una que no puedas cerrar.
es-419.Four pencils. Every pass is someone else: Cuatro lápices. Cada turno que pasa es la oportunidad de otro.
MAESTRÍA: líneas entintadas, un reloj y Vega. Gana por tres.
es-419.MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is p: MAESTRÍA: la hoja más ancha hasta ahora. Vega es paciente; aguanta más que ella.
Gana por cuatro. Cada cadena cuenta.
es-419.MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega,: MAESTRÍA: treinta y seis cajas contra Vega, contrarreloj.
es-419.MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at h: MAESTRÍA: la gran hoja completa. Vega en su mejor momento.
es-419.MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, ti: MAESTRÍA: cuarenta y nueve cajas, con líneas ya entintadas, con reloj y contra Vega. La hoja final.
es-419.Claim the most boxes: Gana la mayor cantidad de cajas
Gana una hoja de 3×3 en menos de un minuto.
es-419.Forty-two boxes against Margot. Settle i: Cuarenta y dos cajas contra Margot. Ponte cómodo.
es-419.Margot opens. Six lines are already inke: Margot empieza. Ya hay seis líneas entintadas. Gana de todos modos.
Tres rivales, una hoja. Termina primero.
es-419.First to Five: El primero en llegar a cinco
es-419.Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never: Compite con Vega por llegar a cinco cajas. La hoja nunca se llena.
Vence a Vega en su propio juego. Sin pistas.
es-419.One shared sheet for everyone today. Mos: Una hoja compartida para todos hoy. Gana quien tenga más cajas.
es-419.Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge bet: Toca (o llega con las flechas a) cualquier lado tenue entre dos puntos y confirma. Traza dos líneas para terminar.
Tres lados de la caja del medio ya están trazados. Cierra el cuarto lado para ganarla.
es-419.Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your: Ganar una caja te deja el lápiz en la mano. Gana las dos cajas en un solo turno.
es-419.A line that gives a box its third side h: Una línea que le da a una caja su tercer lado se la regala al rival. Traza tres líneas seguras: la lámpara marca los lados riesgosos al pasar sobre ellos.
es-419.Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim mor: Juega una hoja completa contra Pip. Gana más cajas que tu rival para ganar.
es-419.Title: Inicio
es-419.Confirm moves (tap edge twice): Confirmar jugadas (toca el lado dos veces)
es-419.Always show button board: Mostrar siempre el tablero de botones
es-419.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Toca un lado tenue entre dos puntos (o mueve el foco con las flechas y presiona Enter). Una línea por turno.
es-419.When your line closes the fourth side of: Cuando tu línea cierra el cuarto lado de una caja, la caja toma tu color y tu sello, y vuelves a trazar.
es-419.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Cada caja ganada da otra línea de inmediato. Las cadenas largas deciden una partida, y regalar una también.
es-419.The third side is a gift: El tercer lado es un regalo
es-419.A line that gives a box its third side u: Una línea que le da a una caja su tercer lado casi siempre se la regala a tu rival. La lámpara de riesgo te avisa antes de decidir.
Cuando la hoja se llena, gana quien tenga más cajas. Los empates se deciden por menos jugadas no válidas y luego por menor tiempo.

de-DE.Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, r: Übung wird nicht gewertet: Rückgängig ist erlaubt, Wertungen bleiben unberührt. Dauer etwa 2–8 Minuten.
de-DE.Draw one edge between two dots. Close al: Zeichne eine Kante zwischen zwei Punkten. Schließe alle vier Seiten eines Kästchens, um es zu holen — und zeichne gleich noch einmal.
de-DE.Pip likes random lines. Take every free: Pip zieht gern zufällige Linien. Nimm jedes Kästchen, das er dir schenkt.
de-DE.Some lines are already inked. Work aroun: Einige Linien sind schon gezogen. Arbeite um sie herum.
de-DE.MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: Margot verschenkt nie ein Kästchen. Schlag sie mit zwei Vorsprung.
de-DE.Three pencils now. Watch who follows who: Jetzt drei Stifte. Achte darauf, wer auf wen folgt — geholte Kästchen bringen Extrazüge.
de-DE.MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: Eine Uhr kommt auf den Tisch. Werde rechtzeitig fertig.
de-DE.MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: Vega zählt Ketten. Öffne keine, die du nicht schließen kannst.
de-DE.Four pencils. Every pass is someone else: Vier Stifte. Jeder Zugwechsel ist die Chance eines anderen.
MEISTERPRÜFUNG: gezogene Linien, eine Uhr und Vega. Gewinne mit drei Vorsprung.
de-DE.MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is p: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: das bisher breiteste Blatt. Vega ist geduldig — halte länger durch.
Gewinne mit vier Vorsprung. Jede Kette zählt.
de-DE.MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega,: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: sechsunddreißig Kästchen gegen Vega, auf Zeit.
de-DE.MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at h: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: das ganze große Blatt. Vega in Bestform.
de-DE.MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, ti: MEISTERPRÜFUNG: neunundvierzig Kästchen, vorgezeichnet, auf Zeit, gegen Vega. Das letzte Blatt.
Gewinne ein 3×3-Blatt in unter einer Minute.
de-DE.Forty-two boxes against Margot. Settle i: Zweiundvierzig Kästchen gegen Margot. Mach es dir bequem.
de-DE.Margot opens. Six lines are already inke: Margot beginnt. Sechs Linien sind schon gezogen. Gewinne trotzdem.
Drei Gegner, ein Blatt. Werde Erster.
de-DE.Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never: Renn mit Vega um fünf Kästchen. Das Blatt wird nie voll.
Schlag Vega mit ihren eigenen Waffen. Keine Tipps.
de-DE.One shared sheet for everyone today. Mos: Heute ein gemeinsames Blatt für alle. Die meisten Kästchen gewinnen.
de-DE.Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge bet: Tippe (oder steuere mit den Pfeiltasten) auf eine blasse Kante zwischen zwei Punkten und bestätige. Zieh zwei Linien, um fertig zu werden.
Drei Seiten des mittleren Kästchens sind gezogen. Schließe die vierte, um es zu holen.
de-DE.Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your: Wer ein Kästchen holt, behält den Stift. Hol beide Kästchen in einem Zug.
de-DE.A line that gives a box its third side h: Eine Linie, die einem Kästchen die dritte Seite gibt, verschenkt es. Zieh drei sichere Linien — die Lampe markiert riskante Kanten, wenn du darüberfährst.
de-DE.Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim mor: Spiel ein ganzes Blatt gegen Pip. Hol mehr Kästchen als dein Gegner, um zu gewinnen.
de-DE.Title: Titel
de-DE.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Tippe auf eine blasse Kante zwischen zwei Punkten (oder bewege den Fokus mit den Pfeiltasten und drücke Enter). Eine Linie pro Zug.
de-DE.When your line closes the fourth side of: Schließt deine Linie die vierte Seite eines Kästchens, nimmt es deine Farbe und dein Zeichen an — und du ziehst gleich noch einmal.
de-DE.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Geholte Kästchen bringen sofort eine weitere Linie. Lange Ketten entscheiden ein Match — eine zu verschenken ebenso.
de-DE.The third side is a gift: Die dritte Seite ist ein Geschenk
de-DE.A line that gives a box its third side u: Eine Linie, die einem Kästchen die dritte Seite gibt, schenkt es meist deinem Gegner. Die Warnlampe warnt dich vorher.
Ist das Blatt voll, gewinnen die meisten Kästchen. Bei Gleichstand entscheiden weniger ungültige Züge, dann die kürzere Zeit.

fr-FR.Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, r: L’entraînement n’est pas classé : l’annulation est permise et le classement n’est pas touché. Comptez 2 à 8 minutes.
fr-FR.Draw one edge between two dots. Close al: Tracez un côté entre deux points. Fermez les quatre côtés d’une case pour la prendre — et rejouez.
fr-FR.Pip likes random lines. Take every free: Pip aime les lignes au hasard. Prenez chaque case qu’il vous offre.
fr-FR.Some lines are already inked. Work aroun: Certaines lignes sont déjà encrées. Faites avec.
fr-FR.MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free: MAÎTRISE : Margot ne donne jamais de case. Battez-la de deux.
fr-FR.Three pencils now. Watch who follows who: Trois crayons maintenant. Surveillez qui suit qui — chaque case prise donne un tour de plus.
fr-FR.MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish: MAÎTRISE : une horloge arrive sur le bureau. Finissez dans le temps imparti.
fr-FR.MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open: MAÎTRISE : Vega compte les chaînes. N’en ouvrez pas une que vous ne pouvez pas fermer.
fr-FR.Four pencils. Every pass is someone else: Quatre crayons. Chaque passage est la chance de quelqu’un d’autre.
MAÎTRISE : des lignes encrées, une horloge et Vega. Gagnez de trois.
fr-FR.MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is p: MAÎTRISE : la feuille la plus large jusqu’ici. Vega est patiente — tenez plus longtemps qu’elle.
Gagnez de quatre. Chaque chaîne compte.
fr-FR.MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega,: MAÎTRISE : trente-six cases contre Vega, contre la montre.
fr-FR.MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at h: MAÎTRISE : la grande feuille complète. Vega au sommet de sa forme.
fr-FR.MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, ti: MAÎTRISE : quarante-neuf cases, pré-encrées, chronométrées, contre Vega. La dernière feuille.
Gagnez une feuille 3×3 en moins d’une minute.
fr-FR.Margot opens. Six lines are already inke: Margot commence. Six lignes sont déjà encrées. Gagnez quand même.
Trois adversaires, une feuille. Finissez premier.
fr-FR.Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never: Faites la course avec Vega jusqu’à cinq cases. La feuille ne se remplit jamais.
Battez Vega à son propre jeu. Sans indices.
fr-FR.One shared sheet for everyone today. Mos: Une feuille partagée par tous aujourd’hui. Le plus de cases l’emporte.
fr-FR.Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge bet: Touchez (ou atteignez avec les flèches) un côté pâle entre deux points, puis confirmez. Tracez deux lignes pour terminer.
Trois côtés de la case du milieu sont tracés. Fermez le quatrième pour la prendre.
fr-FR.Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your: Prendre une case vous laisse le crayon en main. Prenez les deux cases en un seul tour.
fr-FR.A line that gives a box its third side h: Une ligne qui donne à une case son troisième côté l’offre à l’adversaire. Tracez trois lignes sûres — la lampe signale les côtés risqués au survol.
fr-FR.Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim mor: Jouez une feuille complète contre Pip. Prenez plus de cases que votre adversaire pour gagner.
fr-FR.Title: Accueil
fr-FR.Confirm moves (tap edge twice): Confirmer les coups (toucher deux fois le côté)
fr-FR.Always show button board: Toujours afficher le plateau de boutons
fr-FR.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Touchez un côté pâle entre deux points (ou déplacez le focus avec les flèches et appuyez sur Entrée). Une ligne par tour.
fr-FR.When your line closes the fourth side of: Quand votre ligne ferme le quatrième côté d’une case, elle prend votre couleur et votre tampon — et vous rejouez.
fr-FR.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Chaque case prise donne aussitôt une autre ligne. Les longues chaînes font basculer une partie ; en offrir une aussi.
fr-FR.The third side is a gift: Le troisième côté est un cadeau
fr-FR.A line that gives a box its third side u: Une ligne qui donne à une case son troisième côté l’offre presque toujours à l’adversaire. La lampe de risque vous prévient avant.
Quand la feuille est pleine, le plus de cases l’emporte. En cas d’égalité : moins de coups invalides, puis le temps le plus court.
fr-FR.Pointer/touch: tap an edge. Keyboard: {k: Pointeur/tactile : touchez un côté. Clavier : {keys}. Manette : stick/croix pour le focus, A trace, B annule, Start met en pause.
fr-FR.{left} {right} {up} {down} move the focu: {left} {right} {up} {down} déplacent le focus, {draw} trace, {undo} annule (entraînement), {hint} indice, {pause} pause, {skip} passe l’animation, {camera} recentre la caméra
fr-FR.Claim three or more boxes in a single tu: Prenez trois cases ou plus en un seul tour.
fr-FR.No verified scores yet — finish a ranked: Aucun score vérifié pour l’instant — terminez une feuille classée pour en publier un.
fr-FR.Name: Nom
Ce côté est hors de la feuille.
fr-FR.Volumes, graphics quality, frame rate, l: Le volume, la qualité graphique, la fréquence d’images, la langue, les commandes, l’animation réduite, le contraste élevé et la taille du texte se trouvent dans le menu Options de StarHermit.
fr-FR.Offline — progress is stored on this dev: Hors ligne : la progression est enregistrée sur cet appareil.

pt-BR.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Toque um lado apagado entre dois pontos (ou mova o foco com as setas e pressione Enter). Uma linha por turno.
pt-BR.When your line closes the fourth side of: Quando sua linha fecha o quarto lado de uma caixa, ela ganha sua cor e seu carimbo — e você traça de novo.
pt-BR.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Caixas conquistadas dão outra linha na hora. Correntes longas decidem a partida; entregar uma também.
pt-BR.The third side is a gift: O terceiro lado é um presente
pt-BR.A line that gives a box its third side u: Uma linha que dá a uma caixa o terceiro lado quase sempre a entrega ao rival. A lâmpada de risco avisa antes de você decidir.
Quando a folha enche, vence quem tiver mais caixas. Empates são decididos por menos jogadas inválidas e depois pelo menor tempo.

pt-BR.Claim three or more boxes in a single tu: Conquiste três ou mais caixas num só turno.
pt-BR.No verified scores yet — finish a ranked: Ainda não há pontuações verificadas — termine uma folha ranqueada para publicar uma.

it-IT.Play next journey stage: {name}: Gioca la prossima tappa del percorso: {name}
it-IT.Practice is unranked: undo is allowed, r: L’allenamento non è classificato: puoi annullare e la valutazione non cambia. Dura 2–8 minuti.
it-IT.Draw one edge between two dots. Close al: Traccia un lato tra due punti. Chiudi tutti e quattro i lati di una casella per conquistarla — e traccia di nuovo.
it-IT.Pip likes random lines. Take every free: A Pip piacciono le linee a caso. Prendi ogni casella che ti regala.
it-IT.Some lines are already inked. Work aroun: Alcune linee sono già tracciate. Gioca intorno a loro.
it-IT.MASTERY: Margot never gives away a free: MAESTRIA: Margot non regala mai una casella. Battila di due.
it-IT.Three pencils now. Watch who follows who: Ora le matite sono tre. Guarda chi segue chi: le caselle conquistate danno turni extra.
it-IT.MASTERY: a clock joins the desk. Finish: MAESTRIA: sulla scrivania arriva un orologio. Finisci entro il limite.
it-IT.MASTERY: Vega counts chains. Do not open: MAESTRIA: Vega conta le catene. Non aprirne una che non puoi chiudere.
it-IT.Four pencils. Every pass is someone else: Quattro matite. Ogni passaggio è l’occasione di qualcun altro.
MAESTRIA: linee già tracciate, un orologio e Vega. Vinci di tre.
it-IT.MASTERY: the widest sheet yet. Vega is p: MAESTRIA: il foglio più largo finora. Vega è paziente: resisti più di lei.
Vinci di quattro. Ogni catena conta.
it-IT.MASTERY: thirty-six boxes against Vega,: MAESTRIA: trentasei caselle contro Vega, a tempo.
it-IT.MASTERY: the full grand sheet. Vega at h: MAESTRIA: il grande foglio completo. Vega al suo meglio.
it-IT.MASTERY: forty-nine boxes, pre-inked, ti: MAESTRIA: quarantanove caselle, linee già tracciate, a tempo, contro Vega. Il foglio finale.
Vinci un foglio 3×3 in meno di un minuto.
it-IT.Forty-two boxes against Margot. Settle i: Quarantadue caselle contro Margot. Mettiti comodo.
it-IT.Margot opens. Six lines are already inke: Inizia Margot. Sei linee sono già tracciate. Vinci comunque.
Tre avversari, un foglio. Arriva primo.
it-IT.Race Vega to five boxes. The sheet never: Gareggia con Vega fino a cinque caselle. Il foglio non si riempie mai.
Batti Vega al suo stesso gioco. Niente suggerimenti.
it-IT.One shared sheet for everyone today. Mos: Un foglio condiviso da tutti oggi. Vince chi ha più caselle.
it-IT.Tap (or arrow-key to) any faint edge bet: Tocca (o raggiungi con le frecce) un lato tenue tra due punti, poi conferma. Traccia due linee per finire.
Tre lati della casella centrale sono tracciati. Chiudi il quarto per conquistarla.
it-IT.Claiming a box keeps the pencil in your: Conquistare una casella ti lascia la matita in mano. Conquista entrambe le caselle in un turno.
it-IT.A line that gives a box its third side h: Una linea che dà a una casella il terzo lato la regala all’avversario. Traccia tre linee sicure: la lampada segnala i lati rischiosi al passaggio.
it-IT.Play a full sheet against Pip. Claim mor: Gioca un foglio intero contro Pip. Conquista più caselle dell’avversario per vincere.
it-IT.Title: Menu
it-IT.Confirm moves (tap edge twice): Conferma le mosse (tocca due volte il lato)
it-IT.Always show button board: Mostra sempre la plancia a pulsanti
it-IT.Tap a faint edge between two dots (or mo: Tocca un lato tenue tra due punti (o sposta il focus con le frecce e premi Invio). Una linea per turno.
it-IT.When your line closes the fourth side of: Quando la tua linea chiude il quarto lato di una casella, questa prende il tuo colore e il tuo timbro, e tracci di nuovo.
it-IT.Claimed boxes grant another line immedia: Ogni casella conquistata dà subito un’altra linea. Le catene lunghe ribaltano una partita, e anche regalarne una.
it-IT.The third side is a gift: Il terzo lato è un regalo
it-IT.A line that gives a box its third side u: Una linea che dà a una casella il terzo lato di solito la regala all’avversario. La lampada del rischio ti avvisa prima.
Quando il foglio è pieno vince chi ha più caselle. In caso di parità contano meno mosse non valide, poi il tempo più breve.
